steps: Choose a name and username for the bot — BotFather will send you an API token
Paste the token below and click Connect
Create an app in Meta for Developers and add the WhatsApp product
In API Setup, copy the temporary or permanent access token
Also copy the Phone number ID of the test or verified number
Paste both values below and click Connect
Link the studio's Instagram account to a Facebook Page — required for the Direct API
Create an app in Meta for Developers with the Instagram Graph API product
Generate an access token with instagram_basic and instagram_manage_messages permissions
Copy the Instagram business account ID and token, paste them below
Without passing Meta review, the connection only works for the app's test accounts

Choose the account the studio's calendar is linked to
Grant calendar access — classes will start appearing in it automatically
